description: Covers cloud infrastructure virtualization, container orchestration with Kubernetes, serverless architectures, distributed data platforms, and cloud-native MLOps.
learning_objectives: Analyze cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, FaaS) and distributed computing architectures.
Master containerization with Docker and multi-cluster orchestration with Kubernetes.
Design distributed data storage and analytics systems using HDFS, S3, Spark, and Ray.
Implement cloud security, autoscaling policies, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native MLOps.
outline: Cloud Architecture: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless computing (FaaS), multi-cloud and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
Virtualization & Containers: Hypervisors, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, microservices architecture.
Distributed Storage & Processing: HDFS, Ceph, Amazon S3, MapReduce, Apache Spark, distributed machine learning.
Resource Management & Scalability: Autoscaling, load balancing, VM placement, SLA management, energy-efficient cloud systems.
Cloud Security & MLOps: Identity and Access Management (IAM), zero-trust architecture, CI/CD pipelines, MLOps deployment.
